Three.js prompt: Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Render a fullscreen quad with an OrthographicCamera and a ShaderMaterial. In the fragment shader, output color = palette(sin(uv.x*10 + t) + sin(uv.y*8 + t) + sin(length(uv-0.5)*15 + t*2)) where palette() is a smooth RGB function of a single float. Pass time as a uniform updated each frame in the animation loop.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen quad + ShaderMaterial. In the fragment shader convert centered UV to polar (r = length, a = atan2). Compute u = 1.0/r + time, v = a/PI. Sample a procedural checker (step(0.5, fract(u*4)) XOR step(0.5, fract(v*8))) and darken by r so the center stays bright. Animate by adding time to u.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Create 2000 stars as a THREE.Points object with random XY in [-1,1] and Z in [-1,-100]. Each frame add 0.3 to all Z values; when a star's Z > 0, respawn it at Z = -100 with new random XY. Use a small white PointsMaterial with sizeAttenuation true. Camera at origin looking down -Z.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial that raymarches an SDF combining 4 moving spheres with smooth-min: smin(a,b,k) = -log(exp(-k*a)+exp(-k*b))/k, k=8. Sphere centers orbit using sin/cos of time with different phases. March up to 64 steps; shade with normal estimated from SDF gradient and a single directional light.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. Fragment shader: sample 3-octave value noise at uv*vec2(3,1) with y offset by -time*0.5. Multiply by smoothstep(0.0, 0.4, uv.y) inverted (more fire at bottom) and a horizontal falloff. Map intensity through a black->red->orange->yellow->white palette.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. In fragment shader, take centered UV, apply rotation matrix with angle=time*0.3, scale by (1.5 + sin(time)*0.7). Sample a procedural checker texture: floor(p.x)+floor(p.y) mod 2, mixed between two contrasting colors. Use fract() to tile infinitely.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. Fragment shader raymarches an SDF that unions a sphere and a box with smooth-min, repeated infinitely with mod(p, 4.0)-2.0. March 80 steps, hit threshold 0.001. Compute normal via tetrahedron offset trick. Shade with one directional light + simple fog by depth.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Create a CanvasTexture by drawing scrolling text on a 2D canvas (update each frame, x offset = -time*100). Apply texture to a PlaneGeometry with many vertical segments (200x10). Use a custom vertex shader that displaces position.y by sin(position.x*0.5 + time*2)*0.3. OrthographicCamera looking at the plane.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Stack 40 small BoxGeometry cubes (edge 1) along the Y axis from y=-20 to y=20. Each frame rotate cube[i] around Y by an angle = time + i*0.15 so the stack twists. Use MeshNormalMaterial. PerspectiveCamera offset on Z, OrbitControls optional.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. THREE.Points with 5000 particles spawned at origin with random outward velocities and slight upward bias. Each frame: pos += vel*dt; vel.y -= gravity*dt; respawn particle when y < -10. Use AdditiveBlending, a small soft circular sprite texture drawn via canvas, and color particles by remaining lifetime.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. A 64x64 grid of unit BoxGeometry instances (use InstancedMesh for performance). For each cell set instance Y position to floor(noise2D(x*0.1, z*0.1)*8). Color by height (blue->green->white). Slowly orbit the camera around the center.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. Fragment shader iterates z = z*z + c where c is mapped from UV centered on a chosen point (-0.745, 0.1) and scaled by exp(-time*0.3) for slow zoom. Use 200 iterations max; color by smooth iteration count through a sin-based palette.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. A central rotating MeshNormalMaterial torus knot. Place a bright Sprite (AdditiveBlending, soft circular canvas texture) at a position projected to screen, and 6 smaller sprites along the line from that position to screen center, each with different sizes/tints. Update positions each frame.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. PlaneGeometry 20x20 with 200x200 segments, rotated -PI/2 on X. Custom vertex shader displaces position.z by sum of 3 sine waves with different directions, frequencies, and time speeds. Use MeshPhongMaterial with flatShading false; one directional light. Camera tilted down looking at the surface.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. 30 SphereGeometry meshes with random colors, positions in a 10x10x10 box, and random initial velocities. Each frame integrate position with gravity (-9.8 on Y); on collision with the 6 box walls, flip the corresponding velocity component and apply 0.95 damping. Render the bounding box as a wireframe.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. IcosahedronGeometry radius 2 with detail 1, rendered using LineSegments and EdgesGeometry for clean edges. Rotate on X and Y each frame. Black background, neon green lines (color 0x00ff88). Add a second wireframe scaled 1.05 with lower opacity for a glow hint.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. TubeGeometry along a CatmullRomCurve3 with 12 control points making a winding path; tube radius 1, 200 tubular segments. Apply a repeating CanvasTexture (procedural stripes or grid) and scroll its offset.x by time*0.5. Camera moves along the curve using getPointAt(t) with t = (time*0.05) % 1.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. Fragment shader: convert UV to polar, fold the angle into a wedge via a = abs(mod(a, 2*PI/N) - PI/N) where N=8. Convert back to cartesian and sample a colorful procedural pattern (sums of sin(p*freq + time)). The folding produces 8-fold mirrored symmetry.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. 200 small ConeGeometry meshes (or a single InstancedMesh) acting as boids in 3D. Each frame apply three steering rules to each boid: separation (avoid neighbors within 1 unit), alignment (match average velocity within 3 units), cohesion (move toward neighbor center within 5 units). Wrap positions inside a cube. Orient each boid along its velocity vector.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN plus EffectComposer. Render a rotating MeshNormalMaterial torus knot. Add a custom ShaderPass whose fragment shader: (a) shifts R and B channels horizontally by small offsets that change each frame, (b) every few frames replaces random horizontal slices with the source sampled at a different y offset. Drive both effects by time.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN with EffectComposer and UnrealBloomPass. A TorusKnotGeometry with MeshBasicMaterial color 0xff3399 and emissive feel. RenderPass + UnrealBloomPass(strength 1.5, radius 0.6, threshold 0.0). Rotate the knot slowly. Black background so bloom dominates.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. PlaneGeometry 200x200 with 256x256 segments, rotated -PI/2 on X. In a vertex shader, displace position.z by 3-octave value noise (or simplex via a small inline function). Camera at height 5 moving forward along -Z each frame at constant speed; advance the noise sample so terrain appears infinite. Fog added for depth.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial. Fragment shader draws horizontal gradient bars whose vertical positions are sin(time + i*phase)*0.4 + 0.5 for i in 0..7. Each bar is a smoothstep falloff in Y around its center, with a colored highlight->shadow gradient (e.g., blue, red, gold).

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. Fullscreen ShaderMaterial simulating SNES Mode 7. Fragment shader: for each pixel compute world coords by perspective-dividing screen Y, scroll those coords by time, and sample a procedural checker. Add a horizon line above which color is a sky gradient.

Single HTML file using three.js from CDN. 64 BoxGeometry bars in a row. Use the Web Audio API: getUserMedia for microphone -> AnalyserNode with fftSize 128 -> getByteFrequencyData each frame. Set bar i's scale.y to data[i]/32. Color bars by hue across the spectrum. Include a button click to start audio (browser autoplay rule).
